speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are still on the palace side of it. The bed is the other side of the green, and I am taking the walk in this breath. The button stays lost.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And the story stays where I put it. Until the inn, when we are down the river. Not on this grass, and not at the Feathers.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Until the inn. A green is not an inn. I am not spending it on a yeoman's back, and I am not spending it on a pot-boy.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: And no song on the grass. Gladness is not a licence. The boy is tired, and a palace yard is not a chorus.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: He held the dagger and he stayed under. I am not asking him for a note on a path. Come on, Sam. The floor is finished.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I am not going back to the rushes. I can walk. Rosemary on my knee is the whole of what I found.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The scarlet at the door has had his half hour of our backs. We do not give him a speech to go with it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two cloaks are still theirs. I am not counting them in the dark. A count that is not signed is a quarrel with a peg.

speaker: john_heminges
text: In the morning, in a light, where a yeoman can see the two of them. Tonight they hang. Nobody makes a receipt of a peg.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Three things, then. The cloaks, my story, and a bed that is not this hall. I can hold all three across a green.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Hold them without a tune. If you hum I will hear it, and so will the green.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Pope has the stair already. I am not collecting him. Sam walks between us, and he does not kneel on this side of the door.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I will not kneel. The candle is out. I am done with the floor.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then we are done with the number as well. Five pearls stay in the hall. A herb is not a purse.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Five stays where it was said. I am not putting it in a boy's hand to finish the walk.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Three to a bed when we are through our door. Will, you, and I. The rest have their own. Nobody argues an allocation on a path.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I know the bed. I am not inspecting it from here.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have my own blanket, and I am not bringing the story into yours. Until the inn.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The boys come up when I come up. No verse on the stair because a chair was kind. Kindness is not a jig.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The end of it was a rustle, and one cough, and a chair that rose. I am not turning that into a bow on the grass.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Is the play tonight the Sunday one? I thought Sundays were dark.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This one Sunday is not dark. The night is commanded. Morning is prayer, and the prayer is at the inn. I am not preaching it on a path.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Heads in the morning. Cloaks in the morning. No reckoning tonight. God keep you.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And you. The green is short. I mean to treat it so.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Short, and mine still unsaid. I like a green that cannot become an inn however long you look at it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then look at it while you walk. The bed is the third wait, and I am taking it.
